messages:
tara: quick pulse — ran a midroad model (13b-family) quant sweep focused on long-tail doc summarization. attaching compact results + two low-friction rollout patterns.
omar: drop the numbers and sample failure notes pls.
tara: snapshot (slice=longtail-docs, avg input 1.1k tokens, N=520):
```
- p95 latency: fp16 240ms | q8 285ms
- throughput (tok/s): fp16 0.78 | q8 0.33
- cost per 1k tokens: fp16 $0.0102 | q8 $0.0042
- gold recall@5: fp16 80.2% | q8 75.4%  (delta -4.8pp)
- ROUGE-L avg drop: ~4.5 pts
- hallucination proxy rate: fp16 2.0% | q8 7.1%
- notes: failures cluster on multi-doc synthesis + heavy citation anchors
```
link: https://internal.redwood/sparkbench/midroad/3205001234
lucy: econ headline: ~2.4x token-cost reduction. for content-heavy customers that yields big monthly savings, but recall drop looks non-trivial for retention-sensitive flows.
ben: two pragmatic mitigations: 1) adaptive routing by doc-count & novelty 2) mirrored probes (live parallel fp16 copies) for longtail docs to measure real user impact before roll. pseudorules below.
```
# routing pseudo
if doc_count >= 2 or request.tokens > 800:
  mirror -> fp16 (no impact to user) and route -> q8
  if observed_quality_delta > 3pp across 24h:
    route_longtail -> fp16
else:
  route -> q8
```
omar: how big is the longtail slice? small in count but high in exposure?
tara: longtail-docs ~7% of calls but ~55% of knowledge-anchored workflows (enterprise onboarding, compliance reports). small fraction but outsized risk.
lucy: recommended experiment: 1) 48h mirrored probe for 100% of longtail requests (intake both q8 and fp16, only serve q8) 2) 7% canary where longtail 20%->fp16 live routing to measure end-user signals 3) enable KV-prefix caching for fp16 to reduce fallback cost.
ben: ops note: KV-prefix caching historically cut fp16 token spend on long contexts by ~30%. also consider chunked decode: first 512 tokens in fp16 then remainder in q8 for priming fidelity.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: mirror-probe created: midroad-q8-mirror @100% longtail; canary job created: midroad-q8-canary @7% w/ 20% fp16 route. See: https://internal.redwood/deploys/3205001234
omar: for GTN deck please include: unit-econ delta, exposure (% traffic & revenue paths), and 3 churn-sensitivity scenarios (optimistic/likely/worst) tying recall loss to retention impact.
tara: agreed. i'll post 24h mirrored probe snapshot here. next steps: (1) start mirrored probe now (2) ben to draft chunked-decode microbench (3) lucy to run churn-sensitivity model for slides.
lucy: will have draft slides by EOD tomorrow.
tara: thanks. will loop in #product and #gtn after first 24h snapshot. :white_check_mark:
